utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we meeting at the library again, or did you want to change the book club spot?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: The library’s fine with me unless you’d rather try the cafe instead.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The library works for me. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I can bring over a chair and my copy if the club needs one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I might have missed if we already have enough chairs, but bringing your copy sounds great.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club’s on Thursday this week, and I heard they’re doing that mystery novel everyone keeps talking about. You should come, Pia.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday might be tricky for me, but I could try to make it if I can sort out my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, give it a shot if you can. I’ll save you a seat, and I can tell you which chapter they’re on if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be glad to help with the book club. What are you all reading next?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I was thinking we could do a mystery novel next, maybe something set near the library.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great. I can help find a mystery set near the library, or we could pick one with a local author.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you should come to book club this week - I’m spreading the word, and I think you’d fit right in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe this week. I’ve had a lot on my mind lately, but thank you for inviting me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No pressure at all, just come if you can. We’ll save you a seat and catch you up on everything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Leo. I’ve got the book club notes organized, and I can send out the next reminder once we pick a date.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. Once we pick the date, send me the reminder draft and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll send you the draft as soon as we settle on the date.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book club book we're discussing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I think we're on The Midnight Library this week.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to confirm, is it The Midnight Library this week?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds good to me. I just need to make sure it fits between school pickup and dinner.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No problem, we can keep it flexible and I’ll make sure you’re in the loop about the book club timing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me, thanks. Just let me know the time once you’ve got it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club is meeting this week, but I’m not sure what the book is yet. Did Jules mention it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think it’s the one about the old lighthouse, but I’ll check with the group and let you know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, I’m glad you’re checking. If it’s the lighthouse one, I can make it if the time works.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can do Tuesday night if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Tuesday night still works, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, Tuesday night still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t read the latest pick yet, but I’m curious what the group thinks of it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I still need to finish that one myself, but I’d guess the group will have plenty to say about it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m expecting there’ll be a lot to unpack once everyone’s finished it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m in for book club. I’ll circle back to you about the time once I check my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, just let me know the time when you’ve checked your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check my schedule and get back to you with the time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the book club is meeting Thursday, and I’m trying to remember which novel we picked.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it was the one about the missing gardener, but I’m not completely sure.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds right enough for me to jot down; I’ll ask around before Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club. I think I marked it down somewhere, but I may have mixed up the day.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think it’s next Tuesday, not this week. I’ll check my note and tell you so we don’t both show up on the wrong day.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Good catch, Tuesday sounds better. I’ll trust your note this time and check mine too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the book club. I think I missed the last update, what changed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It moved to Thursday, and I think they picked a shorter read this time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thursday works for me, and a shorter book sounds better.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli. I can lend a hand with the book club setup if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Appreciate it, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll handle the books, and you can help with the chairs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll handle the chairs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can bring a couple of flyers to the next meeting if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That would be great, thanks. I’ll make sure everyone knows to pick one up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, book club's been lively lately. Are you coming to the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I might make it if I can get there on time. What day and place are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re meeting Thursday at the library on Maple after dinner, around 7. If you’re running late, just slip in when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Cleo. I can bring the book club list together and send out a reminder after I check everyone’s availability.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep track of the list and make sure we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds good, Cleo. I’ll send the reminder once I’ve confirmed everyone’s availability.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club’s happening soon, but I’m only catching bits and pieces. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s set for next Thursday evening at the library, and I think they’re doing the short-list vote then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know - I’ll try to make it next Thursday at the library and vote with everyone else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in for book club, but I skimmed the details. What are we reading?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re doing *The Midnight Library* this month. I’ll send the rest of the details after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: The Midnight Library sounds good. Send me the rest after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the book club. What are we reading next?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that’s the one we picked?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think so, but I want to make sure before we settle it. What was the title again?
